correctness.rationale: The row-fiber proof is complete: a two-point row forces both neighboring rows empty and bounds the total by four; hence a size-five code is a transversal. The five cyclic increments must each be \(\pm2\) and their sum modulo five forces a common sign. Exhaustive replay over all five- and six-subsets independently confirms maximum five and exactly ten maxima.

value.rationale: The pentagon is the foundational example showing that joint zero-error coding can beat independent use. Classifying every optimizer at the first nontrivial block length is a natural equality problem: it shows Shannon’s familiar slope-two witness is not one convenient construction among many shapes but the unique structural type, with an exact count and stabilizer. This is a motivated finite rigidity fact rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
